task_completion.description: The OpenBCI GUI application is open and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'OpenBCI_GUI' is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: A synthetic board session is actively streaming data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Data Stream' button has been pressed (likely showing 'Stop Data Stream' now) and live waveforms are moving in the Time Series widget.

task_completion.description: The agent interacts with the widget selection menu to add a new widget.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown menu is visible, typically at the top-left of a dashboard container, showing a list of available widgets.

task_completion.description: The 'Focus' widget is selected from the menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a highlight is seen over the 'Focus' option in the widget selection dropdown.

task_completion.description: The Focus widget is successfully added to the dashboard layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new widget container appears labeled 'Focus' containing a solid status circle and a time-series graph.

task_completion.description: The Focus widget is displaying active Concentration and Relaxation metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Focus widget shows text labels for 'Concentration' and 'Relaxation' with associated data or state indicators (e.g., 'Concentrating' or 'Relaxing') while the data stream remains active.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to force-load configurations or bypass the GUI interaction.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the GUI menus rather than commands being typed into a terminal to modify the application state.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual OpenBCI GUI elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual feedback such as button hover states, dropdown menus opening, and the widget appearing within the GUI frame are visible.

integrity.description: The data stream was not stopped to add the widget.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Time Series waveforms continue to scroll and the 'Stop Data Stream' button remains visible throughout the process of adding the widget.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Focus' widget in the OpenBCI GUI does NOT contain a circular gauge or an 'Attention' metric. Instead, it features a solid 'status circle' that changes color and a time-series line graph. The metrics are specifically labeled 'Concentration' and 'Relaxation'. The VLM should verify the presence of these specific labels and the solid circle/graph combo to confirm the widget is correctly loaded and active.
